title: Java I/O & File Handling Basics
intro: Java I/O (fresher level) introduces reading and writing. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the File class (the file-system entry point), then the two stream families — byte and character — and buffering (the performance layer). Stream types follow, then NIO (Path, Files — the modern API). Serialization and try-with-resources close the module at the applied tier.
